currentRoundInspection.method: Three exterior/courtyard pictures visually inspected; standard PMTiles supplies the footprint, courtyard opening and entrance bridge fit. No bespoke surveys or PDFs.
observations: The moat-facing facade has a tall central rectangular gatehouse, crenellated corner turrets, an offset entrance passage, stone-framed windows and a narrow entrance bridge.
Outer corner towers are lower than the gatehouse; side ranges carry dark pitched roofs, selected triangular gables and tall paired brick/stone chimney stacks.
Warm pale grey stone, dark brown roofs and muted blue-grey glazing should come from shared graphs. Seasonal ivy is reference context, not a photograph texture.
The inner courtyard has cream plaster between dark Tudor timbers, three closely spaced gables on the rear range, grouped glazing, and lower stone footings.
currentRoundInspection.usage: External visual references only; images are not downloaded, redistributed or embedded.
